title: Weak Factor Analysis via Temporally Weighted PCA
abstract: arXiv:2508.15675v2 Announce Type: replace-cross  Abstract: Principal component analysis (PCA) is arguably the most widely used approach for large-dimensional factor analysis. While it is effective when the factors are sufficiently strong, it can be inconsistent when the factors are weak and/or the noise has complex dependence structure. We argue that the inconsistency often stems from bias and introduce a general approach to restore consistency. Specifically, we propose a general weighting scheme for PCA and show that suitable weights can restore consistency for much weaker factors under the dependent-noise structures allowed by our model. Under the stronger signal-to-noise conditions needed for inference, we also establish asymptotic normality of the loading and factor estimators. translated_title: 基于时间加权主成分分析的弱因子分析
translated_abstract: 主成分分析（PCA）可以说是高维因子分析中使用最广泛的方法。当因子足够强时，PCA是有效的；但当因子较弱和/或噪声具有复杂的依赖结构时，PCA可能失去一致性。我们认为这种不一致性通常源于偏差，并提出了一种恢复一致性的通用方法。具体而言，我们为PCA提出了一种通用的加权方案，并证明在我们的模型所允许的相依噪声结构下，合适的权重可以针对弱得多的因子恢复一致性。在推断所需的更强信噪比条件下，我们还建立了载荷估计量和因子估计量的渐近正态性。虽然最优加权矩阵可能需要关于因子和特异性噪声协方差的先验未知信息，我们开发了一种不可知（agnostic）的方法，能够从一大类加权矩阵中自适应地进行选择……（摘要原文在此处截断）
tldr: 本文提出一种时间加权的PCA通用加权方案，通过合适的权重消除偏差，使得在弱因子和复杂相依噪声下也能恢复估计一致性，建立了载荷与因子估计量的渐近正态性，并开发了无需先验知识的自适应权重选择方法。
en_tdlr: This paper proposes a general temporally weighted PCA scheme that removes bias to restore consistency for weak factors under dependent noise structures, establishes asymptotic normality of loading and factor estimators, and develops an agnostic approach to adaptively choose suitable weights without prior knowledge.
